granulatorArchitectures.name: Top-Spray Batch Fluid Bed Granulator (50 kg Batch, 1.2 m Expansion Cone, Dual-Fluid External-Mix Nozzle, NFPA 68 Venting)
granulatorArchitectures.classification: Batch Fluidized Agglomeration & Granulator (3-A Sanitary / NFPA 68 & NFPA 652 Compliant)
granulatorArchitectures.filterBagType: Antistatic Conductive Polyester Needle Felt with Reverse Pulse-Jet
granulatorArchitectures.description: Standard industrial batch top-spray fluid bed granulator designed for high-efficiency powder agglomeration, porous granule formation, and instantizing of nutritional and dairy powders. Features precision peristaltic binder delivery and NFPA 68 explosion relief panel.

granulatorArchitectures.name: Wurster Bottom-Spray Precision Particle Coater & Granulator (150 kg Batch, Central Draft Tube, Nitrogen Inerting)
granulatorArchitectures.classification: Precision Wurster Film-Coating & Micro-Encapsulation Granulator (ATEX Zone 20/21 / NFPA 69)
granulatorArchitectures.sprayNozzlePosition: Bottom Spray (Co-Current Spray Inside Concentric Draft Tube)
granulatorArchitectures.filterBagType: Expanded PTFE Membrane Antistatic Needle Felt (Surface Filtration)
granulatorArchitectures.description: Bottom-spray Wurster fluid bed apparatus designed for functional polymer micro-encapsulation, controlled-release flavor delivery, and uniform core-shell coating. The central partition tube accelerates particles upwards through the spray zone, preventing droplet overspray onto vessel walls.

granulatorArchitectures.name: Continuous Multi-Stage Vibrating Fluid Bed Granulator (1,500 kg/h, 3-Zone Thermal Agglomerator, NFPA 69 Rotary Airlocks)
granulatorArchitectures.classification: Continuous Industrial Multi-Zone Fluidized Bed Granulator (ASME BPVC & NFPA 652/69)
granulatorArchitectures.sprayNozzlePosition: Multi-Zone Top-Spray Array (Zone 1 Granulation, Zone 2 Drying, Zone 3 Cooling)
granulatorArchitectures.filterBagType: Aluminized Conductive Stainless Steel Fiber Cartridges with High-Frequency Pulse Cleaning
granulatorArchitectures.description: Heavy-duty continuous industrial vibrating fluid bed granulator for large-scale beverage, soup base, and dairy agglomeration. Multi-zone drying and cooling chambers ensure steady moisture equilibrium, while NFPA 69 explosion isolation rotary airlocks prevent flame propagation into upstream silos.

granulatorArchitectures.name: Aging Degraded Fluid Bed Granulator (Clogged Filter Bags, Broken Grounding Lug, Streaming Spray Nozzle)
granulatorArchitectures.classification: High-Risk Mechanically Degraded Unit (Severe Electrostatic Arc & Deflagration Hazard, NFPA 68 Violation)
granulatorArchitectures.sprayNozzlePosition: Worn Top Spray (Off-Center Stream Jetting & Liquid Puddling)
granulatorArchitectures.filterBagType: Blinded Conventional Polyester Bags (Broken Ground Wires, Resistance > 10^9 Ohm)
granulatorArchitectures.description: Mechanically compromised fluid bed granulator exhibiting blinded filter bags (ΔP > 3.8 kPa), worn spray nozzle orifice producing coarse wet droplets (d32 > 85 μm), localized bed collapse/quenching, unbonded vessel chassis generating hazardous static sparks (>50 mJ), and undersized explosion venting.

powderBinderProfiles.name: Hydrolyzed Whey Protein & Maltodextrin Instantizing Mix (Geldart Group A, High Fat 24%)
powderBinderProfiles.binderSolutionType: 10% Soy Lecithin in MCT Vegetable Oil
powderBinderProfiles.description: High-value infant nutritional powder requiring delicate instantizing to achieve rapid cold-water dispersion. Highly sensitive to heat denaturation and thermal lipid oxidation, with moderate combustible dust sensitivity requiring strict grounding and controlled bed humidity.

powderBinderProfiles.name: Modified Pre-Gelatinized Waxy Maize Starch (Geldart Group B/A, Low MIE <10 mJ)
powderBinderProfiles.description: Fine food-grade functional starch carrier used in soups and culinary sauces. Characterized by high explosion severity (Kst = 195 bar·m/s) and extremely low minimum ignition energy (MIE = 8 mJ), rendering the fluid bed vessel vulnerable to electrostatic brush discharge ignition during dry fluidization.

powderBinderProfiles.name: Agglomerated Instant Cocoa & Cane Sugar Beverage Blend (Geldart Group A, Fat 14%)
powderBinderProfiles.binderSolutionType: Pure Demineralized Water with 2% Malt Extract
powderBinderProfiles.description: Popular breakfast beverage powder containing cocoa solids, lecithin, and sucrose. Susceptible to sugar caramelization and thermoplastic softening above 55°C, causing sudden wet quenching and bed defluidization if spray rates exceed drying capacity.

powderBinderProfiles.name: Micro-Encapsulated Seasoning Salt & Oleoresin Spice Matrix (Geldart Group B)
powderBinderProfiles.description: Dense particulate seasoning blend for snack food coating. High minimum fluidization velocity requires elevated blower volume, generating intense frictional triboelectric charge accumulation in the filter chamber.

nozzleFilterFormulations.name: Two-Fluid Binary External-Mix Atomizer (1.5 mm Liquid Tip, Coaxial Air Cap, Tungsten Insert)
nozzleFilterFormulations.cloggingResistance: Superior (External gas mixing prevents internal tip fouling)
nozzleFilterFormulations.description: Precision two-fluid binary spray nozzle where pressurized air shears the binder liquid stream outside the liquid orifice. Produces fine, uniform droplets with narrow size distribution, preventing localized overwetting.

nozzleFilterFormulations.name: High-Turbulence Internal-Mix Swirl Atomizer (2.0 mm Orifice, Wide 60° Hollow Cone)
nozzleFilterFormulations.cloggingResistance: Moderate (Viscous binder solutions can coat swirl chamber)
nozzleFilterFormulations.description: Internal mixing nozzle delivering broad conical spray distribution. Suitable for high-throughput continuous beds, but coarser droplet spectrum requires careful air velocity tuning to avoid wet slugging.

nozzleFilterFormulations.name: Expanded PTFE Laminated Antistatic Polyester Needle Felt (Surface Filtration, Conductive Scrim)
nozzleFilterFormulations.atomizationPrinciple: Membrane Surface Barrier & Reverse Pulse Jet
nozzleFilterFormulations.description: High-efficiency microporous PTFE membrane laminated to antistatic needle felt with woven stainless steel conductive fibers. Collects submicron dust on the surface, preventing deep pore blinding and providing rapid cake release.

nozzleFilterFormulations.name: Aluminized Woven Epitropic Stainless Steel Micro-Fiber Filter Bags (Heavy-Duty Dust Collection)
nozzleFilterFormulations.atomizationPrinciple: Woven Depth Filtration with Metal Grounding
nozzleFilterFormulations.sanitaryStandard: ATEX Zone 20 Explosive Dust Compliance & NFPA 68
nozzleFilterFormulations.description: Heavy-duty woven conductive filter medium designed for continuous spark dissipation. Features continuous grounding copper cables terminating into the vessel earth ground terminal, keeping chassis resistance below 10 Ohms.
